generation.lineage_note: New works and wording; challenge shapes adapted from the seen V8 candidate. This set is exposed development material.

chapters.title: Kinship Rule
chapters.body: The Orchard Register's permanent kinship rule says that two people recorded as twins cannot be one another's parent.

chapters.title: Twin Register
chapters.body: The birth register identifies Nera and Oren as twins, both children of Tala.

chapters.title: Birth Order
chapters.body: The birth register does not record which twin, Nera or Oren, was born first.

chapters.title: Launch Rule
chapters.body: The restoration boat's launch is complete only after both its manifest is signed and the boat departs the orchard quay.

chapters.title: Launch Log
chapters.body: The restoration boat manifest remains unsigned and the boat has not departed the orchard quay.

chapters.title: Delay Cause
chapters.body: The restoration log leaves the cause of the boat's delay unrecorded.
